Title: Tagged Item Round-Trip - PUT Persists Tags, GET Returns Them
Preconditions: Admin can authenticate against {{BACK_URL}}; the CatalogPersonalization module is installed; a product exists that carries no tags
Test_Data: adminUrl={{BACK_URL}}; targetProduct=live-discover(POST /api/catalog/search/products -> a product whose tagged item has no tags); group=AGENT-TEST-PERS01-{run}
Steps:
[AUTH] Obtain an admin access token (POST /connect/token, password grant)
[SETUP] Resolve targetProduct per Test_Data - a product carrying no tags
[HTTP] GET /api/personalization/taggeditem/{targetProduct} - record the baseline tags collection
[ACT] PUT /api/personalization/taggeditem with targetProduct carrying exactly one group name
[WAIT] The write returns
[HTTP] GET /api/personalization/taggeditem/{targetProduct} a second time
[ACT] PUT /api/personalization/taggeditem with an EMPTY tag collection for targetProduct
[WAIT] The write returns
[HTTP] GET /api/personalization/taggeditem/{targetProduct} a third time
Cross_Layer_Checks: [NETWORK] no unexpected 4xx/5xx on the endpoint under test
Failure_Signals: Spinner visible >5s, 4xx/5xx on the endpoint under test, empty or malformed response body
Cleanup: Clear every tag this case assigned via PUT /api/personalization/taggeditem with an empty tag set; remove any AGENT-TEST- value added to the Customer.MemberGroups dictionary; verify by reading the entity back

Title: Tag Count Endpoint Reports The Distinct Union Of Direct And Inherited Tags
Preconditions: Admin can authenticate against {{BACK_URL}}; a parent category and a child entity beneath it exist, both initially untagged
Test_Data: adminUrl={{BACK_URL}}; parentCategory=live-discover(a category with at least one child entity); childEntity=live-discover(a child of parentCategory); groupA,groupB=AGENT-TEST-PERS02-{run}-A,-B
Steps:
[AUTH] Obtain an admin access token (POST /connect/token, password grant)
[SETUP] Resolve parentCategory plus childEntity per Test_Data, both untagged
[HTTP] GET /api/personalization/taggeditem/{childEntity}/tags/count in the untagged state
[ACT] PUT a single group onto childEntity (the body must include label and entityType - PUT without label returns 500)
[WAIT] The write returns
[HTTP] GET the count again in the direct-only state
[ACT] PUT an empty tag collection onto childEntity (the body must include label and entityType - PUT without label returns 500)
[WAIT] The write returns
[ACT] PUT a single group onto parentCategory (the body must include label and entityType - PUT without label returns 500)
[WAIT] The write returns
[HTTP] GET the count for childEntity in the inherited-only state
[ACT] PUT a different group directly onto childEntity (the body must include label and entityType - PUT without label returns 500)
[WAIT] The write returns
[HTTP] GET the count for childEntity in the mixed state
Cross_Layer_Checks: [NETWORK] no unexpected 4xx/5xx on the endpoint under test
Failure_Signals: Spinner visible >5s, 4xx/5xx on the endpoint under test, empty or malformed response body
Cleanup: Clear every tag this case assigned via PUT /api/personalization/taggeditem with an empty tag set; remove any AGENT-TEST- value added to the Customer.MemberGroups dictionary; verify by reading the entity back
References: VCST-5282 · Archetype:RENDER · Technique:EP · Repaired 2026-10-14 (Stable 16 regression VCST-6042): tags/count returns a single combined integer (PersonalizationModuleController.GetTagsCount @3.1006.1, KB-8BF13808); the {SPEC} direct/inherited split never existed. Expectation rewritten to the single-int contract - still fails if inherited tags are dropped when a direct tag exists, or if a tag is double-counted

Still fails if the entityIds filter is ignored (totalCount = all tagged items) or leaks across entities
